purpose: AI/developer visual investigation of JWEB render geometry, collision geometry and circulation/transport intent using the same runtime authorities as the game
integration_state: parked/inert repository cut; normal main.js runtime is intentionally not modified

modes.world: implemented inside the tool but not wired by this parked cut; after an explicit host seam it can inspect the normal main.js runtime
modes.generator_specimen: one deterministic KowloonFabricEngine payload in an empty scene; main.js and the streamed world are not booted
modes.direct_fixture: geometry-harness spec instantiated directly in an empty scene; no main.js, streamer, world, or Kowloon chunk generation

output: ZIP containing PNG passes plus manifests with semantic IDs, owner/chunk, authority/selection/frame bounds, cameras, exact render fragments, source instance indices, collision/semantic proxy counts, and collision-free color-to-object/color-to-instance segmentation maps
tests: browser: tools/visual-harness/browser-selftest.html must report PASS on a WebGL-capable desktop browser

portability.core_host_contract: THREE + scene + camera + renderer + optional composer + getPayloadEntries/getStatus callbacks
portability.policy: land the harness as an inert tool first; adapt the small JWEB seam fresh only when intentionally enabling full-world capture; no source-text patcher
